                                  💾 Backup & Restore

                                  Everything here lives only in this browser. Export a backup file regularly — compressed automatically for a smaller, faster file — clearing browser data or switching phones loses everything otherwise.

                                  ⚠️ Restoring will REPLACE everything on this phone with the backup file — bills, customers, catalog, loans, Udhaar, all of it. This can't be undone, so only restore onto a phone whose current data you don't need.

                                  ☁️ Cloud Auto-Backup

                                  Automatically saves a compressed copy to your connected Firebase project — no file to remember, works even if this phone is lost. Keeps the last 7 days, one tap away.

                                  🔒 App Lock

                                  Set a PIN so no one else can open this app if they pick up your phone.

                                  🔥 Auto Orders (Firebase Sync)

                                  Optional — connect a free Firebase project so customer orders land straight in your Incoming Orders list, with no WhatsApp step. Without this, the Order Link still works via WhatsApp.

                                  👥 Team Login & Multi-Device Sync

                                  Owner banata hai ek Shop ID + PIN — staff doosre phone pe usi ID se login kare to Order Booking, Retailer Master, Bills aur Routes dono phone pe live sync honge.

                                  Pehle upar "Connect Firebase" karo — Team Login usi project ko use karta hai.
